text:
At 1:46 PM Eastern Daylight Time, a severe thunderstorm was located over Patterson, moving southeast at 30 miles per hour. Hazard: 60 miles per hour wind gusts. Source: Radar indicated.

Impact: Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees. Locations impacted include Hillsville... Fancy Gap...
